provenance.source: Nebula Cloud Studio public showcase representative generator
provenance.generationMethod: Terrain-aware corridor envelope generated from OpenStreetMap Bhote Koshi / Trishuli river geometry, runtime terrain sampling, the published Geopera reference scale, and synthetic depth/velocity curves.
limitations: Representative synthetic simulation output, not official warning data.
No calibrated HEC-RAS, BASEMENT, observed flood polygon, or surveyed high-water-mark dataset is integrated.
Exposure means modeled intersection with a representative flood envelope, not damage or confirmed disruption.
